findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "shippingrates_stats" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "shippingrates_port" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "shippingrates_total_cost" stacks urgency/override words (important, always, mandatory, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
